message.reasoning_content: Now let me look at the chain directory in detail, plus check for any hidden README files.

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "find units/chain -type f | sort; echo \"---\"; for f in $(find units/chain -type f | sort); do echo \"=== $f ===\"; cat \"$f\"; echo; done"}

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "find . -maxdepth 4 -type f \\( -name \"*.md\" -o -name \"*.txt\" -o -name \"*.cfg\" -o -name \"*.toml\" -o -name \"*.ini\" \\) | sort; echo \"--- python/git ---\"; python3 --version; git status 2>&1 | head -5; ls -la"}
